evidence.detail: R145 ClientSidebarPanel is the only live exact-v308 class dependency on rs/gui/a/a, fixing it as a sidebar settings surface rather than the separate plugin panel.

The panel renders exact 'GPU Settings' controls for GPU Mode, Anti Aliasing, VSync Mode, Colorblind Mode, Anisotropic filtering and Smooth banding, wired to the live GPU/runtime settings enums and flags.

The same panel renders exact 'Stretched Mode Settings' controls for Stretched Mode, Maintain aspect ratio and UI Scaling, including Bilinear, Bicubic (Mitchell), Bicubic (Catmull-Rom) and xBR options.
Its listeners persist/apply the selected graphics flags and emit the exact ::stretchflagoff / ::stretchflagon client commands as part of stretched-mode state changes.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the ClientSidebarPanel graphics/settings surface spanning both GPU and stretched-mode controls; distinct from R185 GpuPluginPanel.
